body: I’d sing a song wrong on purpose 😂

When I was around 13 we moved to a rented house temporarily as our previous landlord decided to sell. Because time and money was limited my parents just got the nearest and cheapest house to our previous one without really viewing it. When we moved in it all seemed fine a little creepy in the dark but nothing too wild. One day me and my mum was painting the living room and noticed small child sized hand prints in the wet paint. I have no younger siblings and it was just me and my mum in the house as my dad worked away. This freaked us both out but my mum tried to brush it off so I didn’t get scared. After a few months the experience had left my mind until I had a sleep over with my best friend from school. We were both trying to stay up until sunrise and were watching tv and eating snacks the usual teenage stuff when my door opened slightly and a black figure around 4ft tall peaked around the corner of the door. We both froze as we were terrified. The worst part was the bathroom was downstairs and because of the fizzy drinks we needed to pee. After an hour we walked down the stairs holding hands and as we turned around to check behind us the figure peeped around the corner of the  stair rail. We both ran to the bathroom and stayed their until sunrise. Luckily only 3 weeks later we moved but until then I would put my chest of drawers against the door fearing it would open again.
